label: UV aerosol index (dust/smoke)
notes: Positive = absorbing aerosol (Saharan dust, biomass-burning smoke); can be negative. Monthly value = mean of all quality-filtered pixels in county from 4 (2018-04..2018-12: 6) evenly spaced sampled orbits (not all ~45 overpasses) - noisy, cloud-affected in wet season. Starts 2018-04/07 (S5P operational data begins mid-2018), so the 2018 baseline is partial.
source: Copernicus Sentinel-5P TROPOMI L2 (OFFL/RPRO) via Microsoft Planetary Computer
native_resolution: 5.5 x 3.5 km (7 x 3.5 km before Aug 2019)
